notes: S4.2 incorrectly states that after rst is sampled high, active and cnt must still be zero at the following edge. Synchronous reset guarantees zero immediately after the edge on which rst is sampled high, but the next edge may legally accept a trigger if rst has been deasserted. In that case active becomes 1 and cnt loads PULSE_CYCLES-1. The final RTL itself correctly implements reset, duration, retrigger, expiry priority, and idle behavior and passes trusted simulation and bounded formal verification.
